title: Rewind run reaches the left boundary
statement: Let $k\in\mathbb{N}$, let $x$ be a Boolean word, and let $c$ be a configuration of the rewind machine on $x$ whose state is the start state. There is a natural number $r\le c$'s input-head position $+2$ such that after $r$ steps the machine is halted at input-head position $1$, with all other configuration fields unchanged from $c$; throughout those $r$ steps, every work-tape head position is unchanged.
hypotheses_covered: $c$ is a configuration of the rewind machine on $x
The state of $c$ is the start state
